entries.wording: Consignment received at the PostNL Acceptance Centre
entries.note: The Transit category also covers PostNL's acceptance scans.

entries.wording: The item is received by PostNL
entries.note: An item scan that can follow the acceptance centre scan by days; stays with the Transit category.

entries.wording: The shipment is handed over in bulk final acceptance of the item to be confirmed
entries.note: The Transit category also covers PostNL's acceptance scans.

entries.wording: Driver is en route to the pickup location
entries.note: Seen on the way to a pickup point; the Processing category would read it as acceptance.

entries.wording: Undeliverable item, has been returned to shipper
entries.note: The Undelivered category also covers attempts that end in a new delivery.
